name: Edwin Bell Forsythe
desc: Member of the United States House of Representatives from New Jersey (1916-1984)

offices.t: Mayor of Moorestown Township, New Jersey

summary: Edwin Bell Forsythe (January 17, 1916 – March 29, 1984) was an American Republican Party politician from New Jersey who represented parts of Burlington, Ocean, and Camden counties in the United States House of Representatives from 1970 until his death from lung cancer in 1984.
